name: conceptual design
wording: The design state, computed from the concept journal for a model to read: the project's purpose, then each bounded context's subject and place in the context map, then its live concepts each as name ≜ residue, and any competing versions none has settled; nothing else. Decisions, the reasons versions were written, earlier versions and retired concepts are history, read apart and never part of it. It is the north star work is accepted against; plain words for the operator come only from a read-back of it.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history.
